mxCell.value: Fleet Context - fuel_type: electric | combustion (app-level enum) - status: active, inactive, maintenance, critical, charging - EV fields: battery_level, charging_status - Combustion fields: fuel_level, hours_run - Enums enforced in app; add CHECK via Alembic if needed

Helpdesk Rules - priority: low, medium, high - status: open, inprogress, resolved, closed - SLA targets: 2h / 4h / 8h / 24h - sla_deadline computed at creation - resolved_at should be after created_at

Legend * = NOT NULL «PK» primary key «FK» foreign key «UQ» unique «DF x» default value ||--o{ one-to-many ER arrows Yellow notes = schema comments Tables match backend/app/models (PostgreSQL, Flask-SQLAlchemy) assets and compliance_checks are standalone (no FKs)

Cascade and Integrity - maintenance_records and ticket_comments: SQLAlchemy cascade='all, delete-orphan' - FKs have no ondelete in DB (NO ACTION) - Add ondelete='CASCADE' for DB-level cascade - incidents / routes: NOT NULL FK blocks vehicle delete
